# Racoon Math Library
_Do you create data packs for Minecraft but find yourself frustrated by the lack of certain mathematical tools?_

**This library is for you!**

RML implement a lot of mathematicals functions (like Square Root, Radix Sort, Vector, Trigonometry,...) in an efficient way to be used by datapack makers.
(You can find details on how to use them in the changelogs)


![Performance for an hundred call of the sqrt function per tick](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c35f19e7c6f2748ceecadf81521fd49f0e1350f0.png)

_Performance for an hundred call of the sqrt function of a random value between 1 and 2147483647 per tick_


![Macro Free](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6082763f401d4fad5d75cdd76a2aa6edf68a9de1.png)
### This pack is Macro Free
To optimize the tools of this pack macros are'nt used in!
